Subject: Proposal for Six-Week Invoice Handling Pilot

Hi Morgan,

I am writing to propose our six-week pilot to assess your invoice handling process. We understand you are hoping for a 20% shorter handling time. Because no baseline or measured savings currently exists, this pilot is the ideal way to evaluate potential results in a controlled environment. Please note that a full production rollout is excluded from this initial scope. 

We are proposing a $30,000 fixed fee for the pilot. Currently, no start date has been approved, as security approval is required before our team can access your client data. 

To keep our momentum going and get closer to achieving your efficiency targets, could you please confirm if you approve the pilot scope and the $30,000 fee, subject to the required security clearance? 

Once we have your approval, we can begin the security clearance process and determine an official start date. 

Best regards,

Jordan
Engagement Lead
